stories.h: Peninsula schools set Dec. 3 I-638 athlete deadline
stories.s: Gig Harbor-area girls' sports athletes need a provider's biological-sex attestation by Dec. 3, following WIAA guidance. Without it they can practice but not compete. A court hearing that same day could pause the rule.

stories.h: Fatal crash at Allen Road and SR 702 near Yelm
stories.s: Troopers say an SUV driver failed to yield Wednesday evening and hit a pickup carrying four people, killing an unbelted passenger. The intersection between Yelm and Eatonville was closed for about 4.5 hours.

coming.h: Zoolights opens at Point Defiance Zoo
coming.s: The 39th annual light show runs nightly 4:30–10 p.m. from Nov. 27 through Jan. 3, with timed online tickets. Dog Nights are Dec. 1 and 2.
More than 100 vendors at Peninsula High School, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday and 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Sunday. Admission is $5.

coming.h: Hand recount begins in 80-vote 25th District race
coming.s: Pierce County begins a hand recount Dec. 4 in the Puyallup-area House race, where Democrat Jenn Marie Strickling leads Rep. Cyndy Jacobsen by 80 votes. Certification is set for Dec. 7.
